finding no significant variation in values within the same lake.

prompt.text: Information in the text best supports which statement about Zhao et al.’s findings?

quality ought to evaluate how evenly U abundance and AR are distributed in the bodies of water
they are examining.

sufficient to yield equally reliable information about sediment transport and deposition and

are likely responsible for light detection in the centipedes.

species are.
